'''Merkatto Tam''' was a [[Humanoid/Legends|human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] enforcer for the [[Czerka Arms/Legends|Czerka Arms]] Chief Engineer [[Mex Briggam]]. Mex brought her along to [[Mek-Sha]] to assist him in torturing the [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] [[Jaca Fatal]] for information regarding stolen astronomical data, however the [[Alliance Commander]] interrupted the torture session after Merkatto had only landed two blows. Afterwards, Merkatto waited with Mex for Jaca and the commander to returned from the [[Unmasked research station]].<ref name="TOR:ATftS" />
